pages.title: Chatbot vs AI agent: what is the difference?
pages.intro: A chatbot answers questions from a script. An agent has access to your systems and can do the work: look up a price, send the quote, log the lead, book the meeting. Read only is a chatbot. Write access is an agent.

pages.intro: A coordinator costs $45K to $60K a year, works 40 hours, and leaves. An agent answers 24 hours a day, does not forget a follow-up, and costs a fixed build plus a small monthly plan.

pages.title: Helix vs a freelancer or offshore dev shop
